for the reforestation of denuded areas, for the extension of national forests, and_
for other purposes, in order to promote the continuous production of timber on
lands chiefly suitable therefor," the following described lands which comprise a

plans as may be jointly approved by the Secretary of Agriculture and the Secretary
of War, for the use, occupation and protection of such lands and for the sale of
